classification_policy: Curated membership first; keyword family fallback is navigation-only, not a scientific assertion; uncertain nodes remain unclassified

allocation_policy.scope: Next research decision / preparation, not job launch
allocation_policy.numeric_rank_requires: Reviewed current absolute-WP incremental belief plus measured/declared cost. Historical public priors are not silently reused.
allocation_policy.uncertainty: A confidence interval crossing zero never sets eligibility or a stop by itself. It describes one estimand/design and is not a posterior over the lineage. Null numerical priors mean unknown, not zero; use qualitative priority and bounded cross-family exploration when numeric inputs are indefensible.
allocation_policy.stop_scope: Close an exact recipe or spending path only for relevant validity, mechanism, repeated-outcome or opportunity-cost reasons; preserve materially different descendants and specify whether a proposed follow-up is discriminating, confirmatory, diagnostic or deferred.
allocation_policy.reward_scope: Legacy bandit math assumes standalone/additive system gains. Do not rank a component only by standalone score when its declared role is conditional; register the interaction and evaluate a matched complete served endpoint.
allocation_policy.diversity: Select across mechanism families; keep an exploration share alongside depth on evidence-led branches; log allocation choices
allocation_policy.correlation: Never sum ancestor/sibling improvements. Combination nodes require their own matched endpoint measurement.
